authoritative_scope: this declared research fixture, not a human product request
original_requirement: Maintain a local sequential package-release register in records.json. Missing storage lists as empty without writing. create(label) preserves a nonblank string verbatim, assigns the supplied valid UUID/UTC provider values and starts phase queued, seal open. Blank/whitespace labels reject invalid_label without creating storage. ready requires queued and changes phase to ready. release requires ready, then closed seal. There is no hold/reset operation. release changes phase to released. set_seal(value) replaces seal with open or closed. The invariant is released implies seal closed, so opening a released record rejects invalid_state. All mutations use id lookup: unknown/missing id rejects not_found before any other checks. Transition guards check phase before seal: wrong phase is wrong_phase, then open seal is unsealed. set_seal has no guard: missing or invalid value is invalid_input before invariant validation. All rejected mutations leave exact storage bytes unchanged; successful changes preserve all unmentioned fields. list returns full records sorted by created_at then id. Every successful change is atomically persisted and survives termination and a new process using the same directory. No operation can leave released. Scope: declared operations, well-formed request objects, valid provider UUID/time values, initially absent or valid own-format store, one writer, normal process restarts. Malformed transport, unknown operations, corrupt stores, concurrency and power-loss recovery are outside this contract.
